notes.title: Mouse Clicks and Small Fixes
notes.content:
Added support for the mouse click to be used instead of pressing the interact button.

Fixed the fish and log not toggling properly after loading a save.

Fixed the crates quest not completing after climbing on the roof.

notes.title: Fixed to the pause menu settings.
notes.content: Fixed the dropdowns in the pause menu settings not doing anything.

notes.title: Tried to fix the Game Breaking when Moving between areas!
notes.content:
I think it has something to do with the game saving when moving between areas at the same time it's loading and unloading areas.

Saving isn't needed there (I doubt anyone even knew it did that) so I turned off the saving when moving between areas and hopefully that fixes it.

notes.title: More Precise Painting & Other Small Fixes
notes.content:
Painting the pennant flags can now be controlled with the mouse and the brush pivots around the end of the bristles instead of the tip of handle. You also need to be holding down mouse click to paint or tapping interact to toggle the paint on/off.

Other minor improvements to things that didn't break the game but shouldn't have been happening.

notes.title: You can now finish the game! (Oops)
notes.content:
Two quest weren't getting added: Convert the ladder to a step ladder, and collect the barrels and crates to climb onto the roof.

Since all quests are required for completion and these were never getting added it was impossible to complete the game.

The quests should get added retroactively:

If you have any barrels or crates (item) in your inventory you'll get the quest for collecting them. If you have all 10 barrels and crates (item) it should complete (might require a quit to main menu and reload).

If you have a ladder or step ladder in your inventory the convert quest should be added and it'll will be completed if you have the step ladder.

notes.title: Fixed a bug introduced in last patch
notes.content: The pause menu was using some code from the main menu and was causing an issue with some items existing in the main menu that didn't exist in the pause menu.

notes.title: Fixed Most of the Remaining Bugs (I hope)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed objects not staying disabled when moving between scenes.
[*]Hiding dad's reading glasses and the key in the bird's nest when the player receives the item
[*]Picking up something sweet from the Bakery will always complete the quest
[*]Pennant flags AND step ladder items are now required to hang the pennant flags (before you could hang them with JUST the pennant flags item)
[*]Player should now drop the watering can when leaving the farm area
[*]Removed the cupcake decorating dialogue from the Chef's dialogue. (this content was cut due to time constraints, just forgot to remove the text for it)
[/list]

notes.title: Fixed watering can and Dad not being interactable
notes.content: Fixed watering can not being able to interact with water, and dad not being interactable to complete quest

notes.title: Forgot to add the main quest to the notebook. Should get added after patching.
notes.content: Forgot the add the main quest to the Notebook on pickup (which is required for completing the game). Opening the game again after the patch should add it to the notebook.
